name: Tool — secret_scan
mechanical_verification: Create a file with a fake AWS key, scan it, verify secret is detected

verification_steps.expected: Output indicates secret detected (AWS key found)

pass_criteria.detects_aws_key: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_SECRET_KEY detected in scan
pass_criteria.no_crash: Scanning a clean directory does not crash

failure_modes.misses_secret: Fake AWS key not detected in scan
failure_modes.false_positive_all: Reports secrets in directories with no secrets
